Exact geospatial metadata of every raster entering the polygon workflow, checked against the inference grid (EPSG:32636, 1625 x 2598, 30 m, origin 620610 / 3514560). The 2018 land-cover layer was exported from Earth Engine with reduceResolution(mode) - a categorical majority rule, the only aggregation that keeps a class label meaningful when going from 10 m to 30 m - and reprojected onto this exact crsTransform. 2018 is used as the baseline because the land-cover product begins in 2018; it is the proxy for 2017.
